name: Quiz rules
summary: The "Get ready" rules screen a self-paced quiz page shows before each question: the title, the rule lines (icon and text) and a Skip rules button counting down, as one block centred in the height the page gives it.
highlights: Self-paced quiz rules screen, one block for every slide type
Title, icon rule lines and Skip rules with a countdown
Steps up at 480px and 960px; deck ink, right-to-left safe
Every text comes from the page, translated
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-quiz-rules> — for the rules screen of a mode C self-paced quiz page (self-paced-view.html on a slide type with setting.audienceQuizSelfPaced: true). It is in lib/audience.js, which the self-paced view already loads, so a fix here reaches every quiz slide type at once instead of a pasted block per page. Put it as a direct child of the page's flex-column root; it fills the height and centres itself. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds the skip event and the rules property through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Block
spec.value: title, rule list and Skip rules as one column centred in the height the page gives (flex 1, centred); 16px padding above and below, so on a content-height phone it starts 16px under the top

spec.label: Title
spec.value: "Question x of y" from the page: 20px semibold on a 1.5 line, 24px from 480px, 48px on a 1.2 line from 960px; centred, balanced wrap

spec.label: Rule lines
spec.value: 16px semibold on a 1.5 line, 24px icon, 12px icon gap, lines 16px apart; from 960px 24px on a 1.3 line, 32px icon, 16px icon gap, lines 24px apart. The lines are left-aligned together and the list is centred

spec.label: Gaps
spec.value: title to rules and rules to Skip rules 24px, 32px from 960px

spec.label: Skip rules
spec.value: <aha-button variant="secondary-deck" size="touch" block>, label "Skip rules (N)" counting down and never below 1, a 16px system-arrow-right in the icon-end slot (the button's 8px gap); full width on a phone, from 480px as wide as the rule list, at least min(100%, 240px), at most min(100%, 480px)

spec.label: Ink and direction
spec.value: deck ink on title and lines; dir="auto" on every text; the arrow mirrors in a right-to-left page

props.name: heading
props.desc: The title, translated by the page: "Question 2 of 7", or "Get ready" when the position is unknown. No title is drawn when it is empty

props.name: rules
props.desc: The rule lines, each a DS icon name and its translated text ("system-timer" + "20 seconds to answer"; "system-star" + "Answer faster to get more points"). A JSON attribute, or the `rules` property (an array), which wins until the attribute changes. A line without an icon is drawn without one

props.name: skip-label
props.desc: The button label, translated; the seconds left are added as "(N)". A label holding {n} places the number itself instead

props.name: ends-at
props.desc: When the rules end; the label counts down once a second on its own, never below 1

props.name: seconds
props.desc: The seconds left, when the page drives the count itself; ignored while ends-at is set. Neither set = the label without a count

props.name: skip-testid
props.desc: The data-testid put on the inner Skip rules button ("audience-<slide-type>-skip-rules")

props.name: skip (event)
props.desc: Fired on every Skip rules tap (bubbles, composed). The page ends the rules and keeps its own double-tap guard, so the same tap cannot also press the question's Skip

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

whenToUse.when: the rules (Get ready) screen of a mode C self-paced quiz page, before each question: the default every agent builds with
only when the slide-type developer deliberately asks for a different one; mark its declaring line `ds-lint-allow: rules-screen (developer request: <their words>)`
the participant waits for the presenter, not for a self-paced question

opinion.note: While the rules show, the page hides its timer, progress row, question and its own Skip and Next: the element is the whole scene. It draws the screen only: when to show it, how long the rules last and what Skip does are the page's. Every text comes from the page, translated. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the light-deck example with no deck applied (DS defaults), in the doc page's preview frame.
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-quiz-rules[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;function q(s){return r&&r.querySelector(s)}function cs(n){return n?getComputedStyle(n):{}}var h=cs(q('.heading'));var l=cs(q('.rule'));var b=q('.skip');var btn=cs(b&&b.shadowRoot&&b.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'));return{headingWeight:h.fontWeight,ink:h.color,ruleWeight:l.fontWeight,blockPadding:cs(q('.rules')).paddingTop,skipHeight:btn.height,skipInk:btn.color};})()

title 20 / 24 / 48px; rule text 16px then 24px; icons 24px then 32px
